propositions: A deterministic clarity floor must retain only rules with zero false positives among closed tickets bearing both plan-review and completion-verifier attestations.

Nonempty parsed acceptance criteria checkbox bodies and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections are retained as hard clarity rules; all other candidates are reclassified as advisory or schema invariants.
Exact duplicate normalized AC items are advisory only because redundancy does not render a plan unexecutable, as demonstrated by counterexample 8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88.
Bare sentinel detection must be narrowed to structural value positions and must suppress removal/negation assertions; the broader historical exception for superseded sections is removed.

File-impact and [rebar:id] edge validation belong to write-schema and grounding subsystems respectively, not the clarity score; the latter applies only when an absent symbol claims prerequisite-created credit.
